dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Well, I'd go with my personal specialty, Tatacos.

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: That said, though, it's not hard to make. Almost everyone in Natlan knows how.

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Hehe, were you expecting me to just give you finished product? Nah, I'm going to teach you how to make one!
